decisions: The approved concept is the visual target for the entrance slice, not whole-route acceptance. Native foreground faces share the actual collider contours. Main landings 11 and 12 form a massive cliff retaining their original contacts. A permanent recessed alcove joins inside the opaque roof, narrowing the valley opening during descent. The reference stays outside Resources. Existing grass marks contacts; slate-only foundation art avoids a material change after the paintings. Prepared masks keep generation out of level startup. In-game evidence and traversal are separate from concept approval.

assets.name: left
assets.prompt: Production 2D game terrain painting, matching the approved painterly reference (image 2). Image 1 is an EXACT registration stencil, preserve its canvas aspect ratio, framing, grey solid silhouette and all golden horizontal landing positions pixel-exact. Paint ONLY the grey cliff as natural heavy layered blue-violet slate, varied irregular interlocking slabs, angled strata, detailed small teal ivy, roots, sparse ferns tucked at back of ledges, warm restrained golden moss on exposed ledges and cool blue shadow under overhangs, like image 2. Organic rounded rock detail WITHIN the stencil, do not move landing heights or endpoints. All grey areas are solid opaque rock, no holes, no sky painted inside rock, no separate floating blocks. Golden lines indicate top foot contact (not literal yellow lines); paint natural thin grassy moss edges there, do not add grass across arbitrary horizontal internal lines. Dark navy outside the stencil stays plain flat navy. No cat, water, architecture, UI, text, invented platforms, glow or blur. This is a separated cliff asset, not a scene. Crisp fine brush grain, high resolution, strong material continuity, avoid repeating rows or uniform brick pattern. Fill rock all the way to left and bottom image edges where stencil touches them.

assets.name: rear

This is only the permanent recessed cave wall behind separate collision terrain, not a complete game screenshot.

assets.name: rock
assets.prompt: Original production 2D painterly stone MATERIAL, opaque edge-to-edge 3:2 landscape texture, for a game matching the supplied approved cave concept (style reference only). Fill the entire canvas with tightly interlocking naturally fractured blue-violet grey SLATE slabs, varied medium and small angular shapes with strong geological layering, fine crisp granular painted detail, restrained muted golden mineral flecks and cool crevices.
